question: Motion to Invoke Cloture: Motion to Proceed to S. 5271
result: Cloture on the Motion to Proceed Rejected (52-46, 3/5 majority required)
bill_title: A bill to amend the Help America Vote Act of 2002 to require voters to provide photo identification.
plain_language: This was a vote to end debate on taking up a bill that would require photo identification to receive a ballot in a federal election, with a provisional ballot if the voter lacks that ID. A Yea would have moved the Senate toward taking up the bill. A Nay blocked ending debate.

question: Motion to Invoke Cloture on Husted Amdt. No. 4732
bill_title: Veterans Accessibility Advisory Committee Act of 2025
plain_language: This vote would end debate on an amendment to S. 1383; the sponsor's official statement of purpose reads: “To require voters to provide photo identification.” Cloture needs 60 votes (three-fifths of the Senate). A Yea limits debate on the amendment; a Nay keeps debate open.

question: Motion to table the motion to refer the House message to accompany S. 1383 to the Committee on Rules and Administration with instructions
bill_title: Veterans Accessibility Advisory Committee Act of 2025
plain_language: As amended in the Senate, S. 1383 carries the SAVE America Act, which requires documentary proof of U.S. citizenship to register to vote and photo identification to vote in federal elections. This vote was to table a motion to refer the House message on the bill to the Rules and Administration Committee with instructions. A Yea kills the motion to refer; a Nay keeps it pending.

question: Motion to table Schumer motion to suspend Rule XXV
bill_title: Veterans Accessibility Advisory Committee Act of 2025
plain_language: As amended in the Senate, S. 1383 carries the SAVE America Act, which requires documentary proof of U.S. citizenship to register to vote and photo identification to vote in federal elections. This vote was to table a motion by Senator Schumer to suspend Senate Rule XXV, which sets committee jurisdictions. A Yea kills that motion; a Nay keeps it pending.

question: Motion to Invoke Cloture: Schumer Motion to Suspend the Rules re: TSA Funding

question: Motion to Proceed to the House Message to Accompany S. 1383
bill_title: Veterans Accessibility Advisory Committee Act of 2025
plain_language: This vote is on whether the Senate takes up S. 1383, which carries the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act (SAVE America Act) as amended in the Senate; it requires documentary proof of U.S. citizenship to register to vote and photo identification to vote in federal elections. A Yea begins consideration; a Nay blocks it for now.

question: H. J. Res. 142
bill_title: Disapproving the action of the District of Columbia Council in approving the D.C. Income and Franchise Tax Conformity and Revision Temporary Amendment Act of 2025.
plain_language: This joint resolution reinstates provisions of District of Columbia tax law to conform with federal tax law. A Yea supports passing it in the Senate; a Nay opposes it.
